scope: Evaluation and forecast-eligibility correction on reused lifecycle benchmark, not a new model or energy superiority claim
primary: Score all live-host/resident-VM issued forecasts with available targets, retaining cases spanning VM completion or policy migration; show migration stratum separately
eligibility: Defined at issue time only: host active and VM count positive. No filter based on future error
reference: Recorded power events give exact inactive CPU0; otherwise nearest active CPU snapshot within1second. No interpolation. Out-of-window and unavailable active targets stay explicit
learning: Runtime learner unchanged; post-run references never feed learning
comparison: Old all-host issuing versus live-host-only issuing; same benchmark, frozen predictor, resources, actions and24hour observation. Compare energy/migrations/work counts and common forecast keys
guard: Do not credit measurement changes as predictive energy savings
